criteria.matches_direction: Comparison sheet: open octagonal wheel about 1.75x crankcase height, barrel 18/12=1.5 length/diameter, distinct end flanges, compact chamfered case, layered feet, oil cup and collared stack. No broad copper piece. Opposite service-side view shows barrel; front view separately shows control panel. Minecraft casing bed remains wider and panel fasteners smaller than the illustration.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Native cuboid/45-degree bevel exports; continuous rim corner joins. Dedicated plain steel tile replaces accidental panel-corner sampling, and panel artwork is mapped only onto front faces.
criteria.material_consistency: One referenced material master, coherent iron/steel/brass atlas; assembly casing uses actual refinery-side texture. No copper material placeholder.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Cylinder owns integral front/rear feet; rear space now requires air. Existing full-block component selection/collision remains coarse; this pass does not add a multipart collision engine. Ports and construction positions retained.
criteria.animation_states: Whole wheel poses 0/22.5/45 reviewed; swept radius about 15.2 model units leaves 1.8 units above casing bed. Shaft is stationary, inside crankcase bearing; no support intrudes into wheel sweep.
criteria.native_size_readability: Dial and lever retained; fitted component item transforms retained. Final shader/icon appearance checked next in focused Minecraft scene.
